title: Founder anchor ledger
description: sources/graph/anchors/ledger.json: append-only, hash-chained record of accepted founder anchors. An entry binds the anchor's canonical record hash (without state) and its capture hash at acceptance. entry_sha256 is the canonical hash of the entry without entry_sha256; prev_sha256 is the previous entry's entry_sha256 (null for seq 1). A ledgered anchor that changes, disappears or loses its capture fails validation, and so does any rewrite of an entry that a base revision already holds.
